decisions.reason: The formwork profile system had its own dedicated page in both years. That signals substantial investment and visible commitment at the core of the firm's precast formwork direction, so management would persist with it.
The shuttering magnet block is only mentioned, not featured. It is still a low-cost complement to the firm's central magnetic formwork line, and dropping it would contradict that announced direction.

This magnetic formwork component has a dedicated page and is central to the firm's publicly committed magnetic formwork strategy. Any weak results would likely be attributed to temporary construction-market conditions.
